description: Records a complaints CSV upload that failed schema validation as a FAILED submission whose error report lists the problems

prosecutingAuthority.description: The ou code from the uploaded file's prosecutingAuthority column

fileName.description: The original filename of the uploaded complaints CSV file

submittedByUserName.description: The display name of the user who submitted the complaints CSV file

prosecutorShortName.description: The resolved short name of the prosecuting authority for the submission's ou code

caseErrors.description: Problems in submission- or case-level columns (and rows that could not be read), keyed by case.urn. Present when there is at least one; caseErrors and defendantErrors are never both absent.

defendantErrors.description: Problems in defendant.* and offence.* columns, keyed by defendant.prosecutorDefendantId. Present when there is at least one.
